display.purpose: One page-level H2 per screen. Inter semibold.

body.purpose: All standard UI copy, descriptions, list rows. Inter.

label.purpose: Uppercase, wide-tracked kicker — at most one per major page section.

mono.purpose: Paths, IDs, step indices. JetBrains Mono.

shadows.name: card
shadows.purpose: Resting elevation for cards and divided list surfaces.

shadows.name: popover
shadows.purpose: Medium lift for menus and command surfaces.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Default button variant. Signal Orange fill, white text — the single primary action in a view.
components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; height: 2.25rem; padding: 0 0.875rem; border-radius: 10px; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; border: none; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary { background: #F97316; color: #FFFFFF; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, #F97316 90%, transparent); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #F97316; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Bordered, transparent-fill variant for secondary actions (Cancel, View all).
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: transparent; color: #18181B; border: 1px solid #E4E4E7; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, #F4F4F5 70%, transparent); }

components.name: Destructive Button
components.description: Tinted-opacity red confirm action for irreversible deletes.
components.css: .ds-btn-destructive { background: rgba(239,68,68,0.1); color: #b91c1c; border: 1px solid rgba(239,68,68,0.2); } .ds-btn-destructive:hover { background: rgba(239,68,68,0.15); }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: No border or fill at rest; lowest-emphasis action (back, icon actions).
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { background: transparent; color: #71717A; border: none; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: #F4F4F5; color: #18181B; }

components.name: Status Badge
components.description: Pill badge family. Accent uses Signal Orange tint; success/warning/destructive swap the hue but keep the tinted-opacity recipe.
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; border-radius: 9999px; padding: 2px 10px; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; border: 1px solid transparent; } .ds-badge-accent { background: rgba(249,115,22,0.1); border-color: rgba(249,115,22,0.2); color: #F97316; }

components.name: Alert
components.description: Inline status callout. Warning/destructive use the tinted-opacity badge recipe; default is a quiet muted surface.
components.html: Malformed lines were skipped.
components.css: .ds-alert { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: 12px; border-radius: 12px; border: 1px solid transparent; padding: 12px 16px; font-size: 0.875rem; line-height: 1.25rem; } .ds-alert-warning { border-color: rgba(245,158,11,0.2); background: rgba(245,158,11,0.1); color: #92400e; }

components.name: Card
components.description: Resting surface for grouped content. Soft dual shadow, 12px radius.
components.css: .ds-card { background: #FFFFFF; border: 1px solid #E4E4E7; border-radius: 12px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgb(24 24 27 / 0.04), 0 1px 3px rgb(24 24 27 / 0.06); padding: 1rem; } .ds-card-title { font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; color: #18181B; margin: 0 0 8px 0; } .ds-card-body { font-size: 0.875rem; line-height: 1.25rem; color: #71717A; margin: 0; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Single-line text field. 10px radius, h-9; border shifts to Signal Orange on focus.
components.css: .ds-input { display: flex; height: 2.25rem; width: 100%; border-radius: 10px; border: 1px solid #E4E4E7; background: #FAFAFA; padding: 8px 12px; font-size: 0.875rem; color: #18181B; outline: none; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #71717A; } .ds-input:focus-visible { border-color: #F97316; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(249,115,22,0.3); }

narrative.overview: Chain Hub v2 is a light, premium product surface: zinc neutrals, white panels, and a single orange signal for the one action that matters. It should feel closer to a polished admin product (clear, calm, credible) than a marketing landing page or a dark terminal console.
keyCharacteristics: Cool zinc/near-white neutrals; one orange accent
Inter for UI type; JetBrains Mono only for literal values
Subtle resting elevation; content width constrained for readable line length
Status sits next to content; primary actions are w-fit

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Orange appears only on the primary action, active nav, and focus rings. Status uses tinted emerald/amber/red badges — never orange dots for connection state.

rules.name: The Tinted-Opacity Badge Rule
rules.body: Every non-neutral badge uses border-{hue}-500/20, bg-{hue}-500/10, text-{hue}-700.

rules.name: The Eyebrow Budget
rules.body: At most one eyebrow per major page section. Prefer a single page-level eyebrow.

rules.name: The Surface Radius Rule
rules.body: Controls use 10px (rounded-xl); cards and divided list shells use 12px (rounded-2xl).

dos: Do use only semantic Tailwind tokens (bg-background, text-foreground, border-border, bg-primary, etc.).
Do keep Signal Orange rare: one primary action, one active nav state, one focus ring per view.
Do prefer divided lists over stacks of soft cards for sequential content.
Do keep primary buttons w-fit unless a form footer truly needs full width.
Do use lucide-react exclusively for icons, and sonner exclusively for toast feedback.
donts: Don't use 40px / pill stadium cards on wide layouts.
Don't use parchment/cream neutrals or a second saturated accent.
Don't put marketing-length headlines on utility screens.
Don't full-bleed primary CTAs inside list rows.
Don't build custom button/input/badge from scratch — extend components/ui/.
